claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Epic Boon is a permanent, passive level-up grant — not an activated feature. It has no use_count, no reset cadence, no activation cost. The existing 'activation' family mandates all three via ClassFeatureMechanicsHeader. A new family (e.g. 'passive_grant') is needed for features that permanently bestow something on the character at level-up with no runtime toggle.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is granting access to an entire feat unit record — not a narrowly scoped runtime effect. No v4 effect atom covers this. grant_proficiency and grant_spell_access are the closest analogues, but a feat grant enables a full separate mechanics block, not a single proficiency or spell list entry. Distinct atom needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Spell Recall is recommended.
